summary: Keep large Karma raid counters inside the portrait WebKit safe inset

spec.reason: The raid flow, values, and persistence behavior are unchanged.

design.reason: The portrait boss label now uses 22 px type to preserve the existing 40 px tested canvas inset on Linux WebKit.

validation: The large raid counter WebKit regression keeps every raid modal label within its asserted portrait and landscape bounds.
The rotation assertion waits for the landscape raid modal bounds instead of sampling the outgoing portrait modal.
The saved raid values remain unchanged across portrait and landscape layouts.
limitations: Physical iOS and Android devices and external portal previews remain unverified.
